entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: What kind of game will it be this time?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: No matter what you bring out, we will[n]emerge victorious.

entries.speaker: Shadow Sae
entries.en: You're making a grave mistake if you[n]think you have me cornered.

entries.speaker: Shadow Sae
entries.en: I only guided you here because this place[n]allows me to fight to my heart's content.

entries.speaker: Shadow Sae
entries.en: When my father died in the line of duty,[n]I hated his killer from the bottom of my[n]heart.

entries.speaker: Shadow Sae
entries.en: Dying to uphold justice sounds virtuous,[n]but the ones left behind have to clean up[n]the mess!

entries.speaker: Shadow Sae
entries.en: Can you imagine the hardships I had to[n]endure!?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Perhaps I had overestimated her.[n]I thought her reasoning would have[n]been more noble somehow.

entries.speaker: Shadow Sae
entries.en: Justice cannot yield to evil! I must win,[n]no matter what!

entries.speaker: Shadow Sae
entries.en: All we need to do to determine who is[n]right... is battle.
